paths.name: typesense
paths.message: Frontend must NEVER reach Typesense directly — call /api/search instead. See docs/adr/0005-search-sidecar.md.

patterns.message: Frontend must NEVER reach Typesense directly — call /api/search instead. See docs/adr/0005-search-sidecar.md.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Use the typed apiGet/apiPost/apiPatch/apiDelete from @/lib/api instead of raw fetch(). The wrapper attaches the Firebase ID token, normalises errors as ApiError, and handles retries / CORS / aborts uniformly. Legitimate exceptions (direct cross-origin uploads to signed URLs, etc.) need an inline `// eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax` with a short why.
